limitations: TR-6 provides no specimen IDs; each produce appears to be photographed as a small number of specimens over consecutive days, so specimen identity is shared across partitions.
Session grouping keeps the 17 near-identical views of one capture together, but sessions from the same produce/day can still fall in different partitions (see leakage_checks).
Spoiled/Not_spoiled are dataset folder labels that follow capture date; they were not independently verified.

config.selection_metric: val composite macro-F1 = mean(type macro-F1, spoilage macro-F1)
config.scheduler: linear warm-up then cosine decay (per step)

bootstrap.method: cluster bootstrap over test capture sessions (64 sessions), 2000 resamples, seed 0

split_leakage.split_scheme: random split of raw sRGB files (Classified + Normal copies), seed 42
random split of de-duplicated contents (no grouping), seed 42
session-grouped split v1 (used for all main results)

dncnn_v1.note: Synthetic noise on clean val images; not real sensor noise.

dncnn_v2.note: Synthetic noise on clean val images; not real sensor noise.

noise_profile.interpretation: Intrinsic noise of TR-6 photos is far below the synthetic stress levels; robustness results are stress tests, not measurements of TR-6 sensor noise.

generation.interpretation: If generated NN distances were far below real-real NN distances, that would suggest memorisation. Real-real distances are small because TR-6 has 17 near-identical views per session.

label_consistency_by_primary_vit.note: Primary ViT-B (trained on real data only) applied to GAN images; agreement with the conditioning label.

vit_frozen.preprocessing: StandardScaler + PCA(50), both fitted on train
vit_frozen.k_selection: max train silhouette over k=2..12 (labels not used)
vit_frozen.note: Clusters are exploratory and are not ground-truth classes.

colorhist.preprocessing: StandardScaler + PCA(50), both fitted on train
colorhist.k_selection: max train silhouette over k=2..12 (labels not used)
colorhist.note: Clusters are exploratory and are not ground-truth classes.

faithfulness.occlusion: top-20% rollout patches vs random 20% patches replaced by the per-channel mean pixel
limitations: Rollout ignores MLP blocks and value vectors; it is an approximation.
Explanations are qualitative diagnostics, not proof of correctness.
No reviewed decay masks exist, so overlap with true decay regions cannot be measured.

stability.method: Spearman rank correlation of 14x14 rollout maps

resources.hardware: Apple M5, 16 GB unified memory; torch 2.14.1
resources.note: Single-image forward pass only (no decode/resize). Measured while other training jobs may share the GPU.
resources.backend_rss_method: macOS `footprint`/`vmmap --summary` on the running uvicorn process after ~200 requests (RSS is unreliable on macOS because idle pages are compressed). Includes 393 MB GPU (IOAccelerator) memory for the MPS model.
